# Groww — Weekly Review Pulse (Week of 2026-10-19)

Window: 2026-08-03 – 2026-10-25 | Reviews analyzed: 2144 | Avg rating: 3.0

## Top Themes

1. Customer Support Delays — 19% — Users wait days for replies on account, KYC and refund tickets.
2. Chart Bugs After Update — 12% — Since the latest update, charts lag and the back button disappears.
3. High Brokerage Charges — 10% — Small investors find brokerage and annual fees high and poorly explained.

## What Users Said

- "Customer care never replies to my ticket. It has been ten days and my account is still blocked." (★1)
- "After the latest update the chart opens a scalper option and the back button disappears from the screen" (★1)
- "Hidden charges on every order, the annual fee was deducted without any clear notice" (★1)

## Action Ideas

1. Customer Support Delays: publish a 48-hour first-response target for tickets and track it weekly.
2. Chart Bugs After Update: ship a hotfix restoring the back button and make scalper mode opt-in.
3. High Brokerage Charges: show a full fee breakdown before every order and in the annual statement.
